title: Add HTML item list endpoint to Go HTTP server
description: Brownfield Go task: add an in-memory item store and an HTML listing endpoint to the go-http-server.

task_spec.prompt:
Extend internal/handler/items.go. The existing test must still pass.

  type Item struct {
      ID    int
      Name  string
      Price float64
  }

  var items = []Item{
      {ID: 1, Name: "Widget A", Price: 9.99},
      {ID: 2, Name: "Widget B", Price: 19.99},
  }

  — Update ListItems to return {"items": items} (JSON, same key as before)
  — Add HTMLListItems(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)
      * GET only; 405 for other methods
      * Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
      * Renders an HTML table with columns: ID, Name, Price
      * Use html/template with a package-level var for the template
      * Price formatted as $X.XX (use fmt.Sprintf or template action)

All existing tests must still pass.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: Item struct defined with ID, Name, Price fields
ListItems returns JSON with 'items' key containing Item slice
HTMLListItems returns 200 with text/html content type
HTML table contains ID, Name, Price columns
followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `go test ./...` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.
